newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs erase gains, end off as Wall St falls.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs erase gains, end off as Wall St falls.

text.p: Brazilian stocks lost early gains to end lower on profit-taking, influenced by Wall Street which fell on fears that the Federal Reserve would raise interest rates soon, traders said.
The Bovespa index closed off 0.33 percent at 65,124 points. Volume was again disappointing, according to traders, totalling a moderate 373.2 million reais ($366.2 million).
Fears of a U.S. rate hike emerged after comments by a senior Fed official that he saw a consensus for a 25-basis-point rate increase in the Fed funds.
The Federal Open Market Committee meets on September 24.
"The rate hike issue was the excuse some investors needed to take profits," a broker said, noting the market's rise in the last two sessions contributed to a correction in prices.
Analysts said the profit-taking movement could continue Wednesday, especially if weakness on Wall Street bond and stock markets persists.
Benchmark Telebras preferred closed down 0.74 percent at 80.10 reais.
in the last two days, fell 0.34 percent to close at 294 reais.
Private bank BCN preferred fell 2.39 percent to 7.75 reais amid a press report saying bank BBA Creditanstalt was about to acquire control of the bank.
In a statement sent to the stock exchanges, BCN denied takeover talks with BBA.
"BCN's Board of Directors says there is no truth in the report and it does not deserve to be considered, no matter the source (it comes from)," the statement said.
Earlier the two institutions had denied the report.
The Sao Paulo bourse's power sector index (IEE) comprising the nine most liquid stocks of the sector, fell 0.32 percent, closing at 1,621 points.
